title: 🔥LA GUÍA DEFINITIVA DE BLENDER! (Curso completo en Español) | Desde cero! 4.5

chapters.title: Modelar la taza y el plato

about: What Lucius kept from this tutorial: one recipe per chapter, each continuing from the scene of the one before. Replay with `lucius teach course courses/lrlpwIumFnE` (no API needed).

lessons.title: Interfaz
lessons.note: Every operation the tutor shows that changes the scene: modifier from the properties panel, axis-locked G/R/S and resets, delete all, cube and Suzanne, edit-mode face move/scale, Suzanne's ears stretched with proportional editing (checked in a separate render), filled circle as the mug base. Viewport navigation itself is not a scene change.

lessons.title: Modelar la taza y el plato
lessons.note: Rebuilt the tutor's way: D handle by extruding a 2x2 patch and rotating 45 degrees four times, deleting the end and a lower patch (X > Faces) and bridging; plate insets stepped into a rim, slope and well with support loops, thickness extruded down and in, foot ring, bevelled rim. Close-ups match 48:00-49:00 (mug) and 53:40-55:20 (plate); small differences in handle cross-section and rim curvature.

lessons.title: Modelar donut y croissant
lessons.note: Croissant the tutor's way (8-gon, mirror, E/S/R segments with pinched grooves, fat middle, drooping horns via proportional editing, flattened, top rounded) matches 1:07:00; fat Clouds-displaced donuts, the stretched duplicate tilted and resting on the first with sagging sides like 1:18:30. Not reproduced: the extra Ctrl+R support loops that sharpen the grooves.

lessons.title: Sistema de partículas
lessons.note: Particle system the tutor's way (Suzanne first, then the sugar cube: hair, render as object, 5000, random scale) on both donuts; layout matches the top view at 1:25:00 (plate centre with donuts, croissant back-left, mug back-right, mug a little bigger); drop_object replaces the by-eye G Z so nothing passes through the plate or floor.

lessons.title: Materiales
lessons.note: Metal demo (gold, bronze, silver) then the tutor's materials with his stated values: porcelain shared by mug and plate, golden oily donut dough shared, glossy half-transparent sugar, toasted rough croissant, SSS 0.5, tablecloth brick check (freq 1, 0.5/0.5, white/white, blue mortar) with magic bump 200/15. Looks match 1:34:45-1:44:30; sugar a little more visible than the tutor's at this point.

lessons.title: Iluminación
lessons.note: All four light types demonstrated on one light (point 400, sun 1, spot aimed at the plate, area as a window); warm 3200 K point at the back with a bigger radius lowered to a detail; the tried-and-deleted area light; the high spot near the camera with cone and blend; dark world. The lit render matches the tutor's dark, warm pool of light at 1:51:00.

lessons.title: Cámara
lessons.note: Camera framed like the tutor's (front, high, plate centred, croissant back-left, mug back-right); scene scaled x0.05 to real size (plate 30 cm); lights lowered to keep the look (the tutor's own numbers 10/100 W assume his exact scale and Eevee); DOF on the donut at f/1; square 1080 with a little more zoom. Not reproduced: viewport-only settings (camera clipping demo, passepartout, lock camera to view).

lessons.title: Renderizado
lessons.note: Final Cycles render (256 samples + denoise, Standard) after the Eevee setup step; key area panel front-left 4500 K, rim raised, brighter glossier croissant, bigger sugar, blue cloth with small white squares turned 7 degrees, f/2.8. Matches the tutor's final at 2:10:20 in layout, materials and light; the croissant is a little more orange.
